main_measure.name: mean excess next-bar return (vs coin holding mean) on forecast > 0 bars
main_measure.threshold: confirm if mean > 0 with t >= 2.0; reject if mean < 0 with t <= -2.0; else inconclusive; at least 200 bars with forecast > 0

supporting_check.name: OLS slope of excess next-bar return on forecast size (positive expected)

decided_by: The mean excess next-bar return is positive with t >= 2.0 (confirm rule).
reading: Holding mean is each coin's mean next-bar close-to-close return over every bar of all its windows pooled; cases are forecast > 0 bars with a next bar in the same window; the 200-bar minimum not reached is reported as not observable; uptrend checked on the regime column.
